name: Yokohama Red Brick Warehouse
description: Restored Meiji-era brick warehouses on the waterfront now housing shops, restaurants, and event halls, beside the Red Brick Park promenade.
reservation: No reservation required for building entry.
parking: Paid parking space available adjacent to Red Brick Park.
notes: Enjoy shopping, oceanfront craft beers, and seasonal events in historic Meiji-era brick buildings.
